briefTitle: Patient Reminders, Education, and Nurse Navigation After Nephrostomy Tube Placement: A Pilot Trial
officialTitle: A Multiphase Optimization Strategy to Reduce Delays in Management of Chronic Nephrostomy Tubes

arms.label: Usual Care
arms.description: Condition A. Participants receive usual care and complete the same surveys. No study components are delivered.

arms.label: Navigation Only
arms.description: Condition B. Participants receive nurse navigation. They do not receive reminder messages or the patient education workbook.

arms.label: Workbook and Navigation
arms.description: Condition C. Participants receive the patient education workbook and nurse navigation. They do not receive reminder messages.
interventions: Behavioral: My Nephrostomy Patient Education Workbook

arms.label: Reminder Only
arms.description: Condition D. Participants receive reminder messages. They do not receive the patient education workbook or nurse navigation.

arms.label: Reminder and Navigation
arms.description: Condition E. Participants receive reminder messages and nurse navigation. They do not receive the patient education workbook.

arms.label: Reminder and Workbook
arms.description: Condition F. Participants receive reminder messages and the patient education workbook. They do not receive nurse navigation.
interventions: Behavioral: My Nephrostomy Patient Education Workbook

arms.label: Workbook Only
arms.description: Condition G. Participants receive the patient education workbook. They do not receive reminder messages or nurse navigation.
interventions: Behavioral: My Nephrostomy Patient Education Workbook

arms.label: Reminder, Workbook, and Navigation
arms.description: Condition H. Participants receive the patient education workbook, reminder messages and nurse navigation.
interventions: Behavioral: My Nephrostomy Patient Education Workbook

eligibility.text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18 years or older
* Nephrostomy tube placement or exchange at Henry Ford Health within the past 2 years
* Tube placed for current or prior ureteral obstruction
* Active MyChart patient portal account

Exclusion Criteria:

* Nephrostomy tube placed for a reason other than ureteral obstruction
* Already under the care of a urologist for the tube
* Took part in Aim 1 of this study as a focus group participant or patient advisor
